model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions (k) and coverage for different models, including Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)" and has a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2^0 to 2^8, with tick labels at powers of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Coverage" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0.4 to 0.9 (though the exact upper limit is not visible), with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot includes four lines: Llama-3B (dark blue, solid line), Llama-3B + FT (green triangles, dashed line), Llama-1B (light blue, solid line), and Llama-1B + FT (light green triangles, dashed line). The dark blue line (Llama-3B) starts at approximately 0.45 at 2^0 and increases to around 0.95 at 2^8. The green dashed line (Llama-3B + FT) begins at about 0.43 at 2^0 and rises to roughly 0.96 at 2^8. The light blue line (Llama-1B) starts at approximately 0.38 at 2^0 and reaches around 0.88 at 2^8. The light green dashed line (Llama-1B + FT) begins at about 0.36 at 2^0 and increases to roughly 0.9 at 2^8. All lines exhibit an overall increasing trend as the number of completions (k) increases.
